result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The presence of streetcar tracks in the roadway and wide turning radii create potential hazards for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Tracks embedded in the pavement can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the bottom of the frame

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signals at a signalized intersection increases the risk of conflicts with turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear right-of-way information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns.

result.summary: The intersection features wide roadways with multiple travel lanes and a single marked crosswalk, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the long crossing distances increase risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible to guide safe crossing times at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and patched pavement in the intersection area could pose a trip hazard or affect vehicle control.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade existing markings to continental style and add them to all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by a large gas station lot, which creates multiple vehicle conflict points across the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven surfaces in the roadway and crosswalk area can cause tripping or vehicle instability.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner near the gas station

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to clearly communicate right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk to provide a smooth, safe walking and driving surface.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and signalization. However, safety is compromised by faded pavement markings, poor road surface quality, and the presence of trolley tracks which create tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Trolley tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway create uneven surfaces and can be slippery, posing a trip hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running parallel to the main street

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the side street

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and patching in the asphalt near the crossing area increases the risk of stumbles.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area and near the tracks

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, level walking surface, particularly around the trolley tracks.
